# Damned Designs

> Damned Designs makes precision EDC objects: folding knives, fixed blades, lanyard beads, fidget pieces, and apparel. Founded by Adrian D'Souza in New York. Premium materials (S35VN, 14C28N, D2, titanium, G10, copper) manufactured by reputable OEMs (Kubey, Bestech). Built to be carried, not collected.

## Key facts

- **Materials used:** S35VN, 14C28N, D2, 9Cr18MoV (steels); titanium, G10, Micarta, copper (handles)
- **Manufactured by:** Kubey and Bestech (China-based OEMs with quality reputation)
- **Price range:** $30-$150 USD
- **Ships from:** California, USA
- **Business address:** 169 Madison Ave, New York, NY 10016
- **Founder:** Adrian D'Souza
- **Email:** info@damneddesigns.com
- **Warranty:** Manufacturing defects covered
- **Returns:** [Returns & Refunds](https://www.damneddesigns.com/returns/)

## Brand positioning

Damned Designs sits in the mid-tier EDC market with Civivi, Kizer, QSP, and CJRB. Differentiators: bold brutalist aesthetics, chunky-yet-ergonomic form factor, satisfying deployment actions, transparent value pricing with premium-tier materials. Editorial voice is dark, considered, dry — not tactical, not hypebeast.

## Comparisons

- **vs Civivi:** Similar price tier; Damned Designs has bolder aesthetics, Civivi has broader retail distribution.
- **vs Kizer:** Comparable OEM quality; Damned Designs emphasizes chunky brutalist form, Kizer leans modern-tactical.
- **vs Benchmade:** Damned Designs is roughly one-third the price with comparable materials on select models.
- **vs Cold Steel:** Both overbuilt; Damned Designs is more compact and pocket-friendly.
